in_marathi.name: Nityanand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nityanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who always remains in bliss and self-contentment. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nitya' meaning 'eternal' and 'Ananda' meaning 'bliss'.
